description: Get full details for a single Recreation.gov facility (e.g. a campground) by its FacilityID. Returns description, directions, ADA access, phone/email, keywords, and coordinates. Example: get_facility({ facility_id: "232447" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Recreation.gov RIDB API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: get_facility
title: Get Facility
